literal.prompt: Какая система считается первой коммерческой домашней игровой консолью и вышла в 1972 году?

literalGroups.primaryGround: SOVA L221 states Magnavox Odyssey was released in 1972 as the world’s first commercial home video game console. All alternatives are home-console systems: Atari VCS released in 1977 and was later renamed Atari 2600 (Atari L396,L398-L409); CHM identifies ColecoVision as home console introduced in 1982 (CHM L7-L23); Atari identifies Intellivision as home console released in 1979 (L369-L371). Only Odyssey meets the asked 1972 milestone.
literalGroups.locator: SOVA L221; Atari L396,L398-L409; CHM L7-L23; Atari Intellivision L369-L371.

literalGroups.literal: Magnavox Odyssey стала первой коммерческой домашней игровой консолью: Smithsonian описывает её как потребительский выпуск прототипа Brown Box. Разработки Баера начались в Sanders Associates в 1966 году, а Magnavox продавала Odyssey в 1972–1975 годах.
literalGroups.primaryGround: SOVA L221 identifies the commercial system, release year and Brown Box relationship; L130-L131 place Baer’s project at Sanders in 1966 and Odyssey sales in 1972-1975.

literalGroups.literal: Ральф Баер начал разработку системы в Sanders Associates в 1966 году.
literalGroups.primaryGround: SOVA L130 says Baer began an independent Sanders project in 1966 to enable consumer interaction with standard home televisions, a useful additional fact about Odyssey’s inventor.

literalGroups.literal: В 1977 году Atari выпустила Video Computer System, позднее переименованную в Atari 2600.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Atari says its VCS was later renamed Atari 2600 and places its release in 1977. This is a true distinct chronology for the distractor.

literalGroups.literal: ColecoVision, представленная в 1982 году, стала первой игровой системой Coleco Industries.
literalGroups.primaryGround: CHM states ColecoVision was introduced in 1982, made by Coleco Industries, and was the company’s first game system.

literalGroups.literal: Mattel Electronics выпустила домашнюю Intellivision в 1979 году, чтобы конкурировать с Atari 2600.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Atari’s Intellivision history says Mattel Electronics released it in 1979 as a home video game console competing with Atari 2600.
